traceability.notes: The 009.0-DEV-MAINTENANCE-TOOLS story is fully implemented. Core detection and update tooling is present (detectStaleAnnotations, updateAnnotationReferences, batchUpdateAnnotations, verifyAnnotations, generateMaintenanceReport) and wired both as a programmatic API and as a dedicated CLI (traceability-maint). Targeted Jest suites for detection, update, batch, reporting, CLI behavior, and large-workspace performance—each explicitly tagged with Story 009.0 and the REQ-MAINT-* requirement IDs—all pass. Tests verify correct behavior for stale-reference detection, safe and batch updates, verification, human-readable and JSON reporting, dry-run behavior and argument validation, safe handling of missing directories and permission errors, and acceptable performance on large codebases. README.md and user-docs/api-reference.md both contain dedicated maintenance API/CLI documentation sections. Together, this provides concrete evidence that all acceptance criteria and listed requirements for this story are satisfied.
